"""Build all-case tables and fixed native comparisons after actual quality review."""
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V173-weak-gradient-matching-v1'
assert read(root/'native-viewing-completion-v1.json')['native_figures']==60
assert read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
assert read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')['status'].startswith('pass-')
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert len(notes.read_text())>300
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json');paired=read(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json');audit=read(root/'quality-audit-v1.json')
summaries={(s['kind'],s['condition'],s['cohort'],s['method']):s for s in paired['summary']}
methods=['parent','V169-EMA','V171-EMA','V172-EMA','V173-raw','V173-EMA'];columns=['V143 parent','V169 EMA','V171 EMA','V172 EMA','V173 raw','V173 EMA']
text='# V173 amplitude-balanced gradients: completed quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and exact sources](results/v173-weak-gradient-matching-final-v1.json) · [Native pixels, source ROIs, checkpoint, noise and display metadata](images/v173-weak-gradient-matching-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
cells=[];lines=[]
def table(title,specifications):
 global text
 text+='## '+title+'\n\n| Metric | '+' | '.join(columns)+' |\n| --- | '+' | '.join(['---:']*len(columns))+' |\n'
 for label,kind,condition,cohort,field,digits in specifications:
  values=[]
  for method in methods:
   value=summaries[kind,condition,cohort,method][field];rendered=f'{value:.{digits}f}'
   cells.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=method,field=field,digits=digits,rendered=rendered));values.append(rendered)
  line='| '+label+' | '+' | '.join(values)+' |';lines.append(line);text+=line+'\n'
 text+='\n'
table('Mesh response and actual blank error',[(('Present' if present else 'Absent')+' '+label,'mesh',present,None,field,digits) for present in [True,False] for label,field,digits in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16',6),('signed template gain','template_gain',8),('actual blank RMS','blank_error_RMS_DN16',6),('blank spatial RMS','blank_spatial_RMS_DN16',6),('blank DC RMS','blank_DC_RMS_DN16',6)]])
table('Quiet fields beside detail',[(f'{prior} {label}','mixed-quiet',prior,None,field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('whole RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet RMS','quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('quiet spatial RMS','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('quiet DC RMS','crop_DC_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Native 512-pixel standalone flats',[(f'{prior} {label}','flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',field,6) for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('spatial RMS','full_spatial_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])
table('Natural photographic detail',[(f'{cohort}/{variant} {label}','photo',variant,cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['retained512','organic384'] for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band response','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]])
design=read(plan['design']['path']);adc=next(c for c in design['observations'] if c.get('cohort')=='adc-photo256')
table('ADC-only controls',[(f'Photo {label}','photo',adc['variant']['name'],adc['cohort'],field,6) for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('band error','crop_relative_band_error')]]+[(f'{cohort} {label}','flat','adc-only',cohort,field,6) for cohort in ['fresh-flat512','adc-sloped512'] for label,field in [('full RMS','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('coarse32 RMS','block32_RMS_DN16')]])

text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Template gain 1 means exact constructed mesh amplitude. A small signed absent mean does not prove absence of false structure. Coarse32 is spatially centered block-mean error. All paired values and increase/decrease counts are retained. The adaptively reused cohort does not establish blind generalization or seed uncertainty.\n\n'
text+='## Changed gradient loss and matched training\n\n'
text+='For each horizontal/vertical native edge, let g be the clean target RGB gradient and d the gradient of output-minus-target. The new unit is sqrt(mean_RGB(g²)+(2/65535)²). The gradient loss averages rho(d/unit), with rho(z)=sqrt(1+z²)−1 evaluated by rationalization. Its coefficient remains 0.25. Weak and zero target gradients receive the largest weights. The old term used one image-wide noise unit and a 0.003 Charbonnier transition. Amplitude units and smoothing transition change jointly; their individual effects are not isolated. Derivatives precede normalization, so changing units do not introduce a gradient of constant RGB error.\n\n'
text+='Pixel, local/DC regret, clean-flat anchoring, pair difference and pair common losses retain their exact definitions, coefficients and masks. AST checks and controlled tests prove this six-term isolation. Clean gradients/weights enter training only. The inference graph, all 96 neural files, 2,088,906 trainable parameters/141 tensors, seeded initial state, frozen V169 EMA/V143-DINO parent, V168 cache/pair units and AdamW/LR/clipping/EMA match V172. The training loop differs only in its criterion import and formatter ordering. There are no released V170 weights. [Original protocol](results/v173-weak-gradient-matching-v1/original-protocol-v1.md) · [Prepared sources](results/v173-weak-gradient-matching-preparation-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='The selected training-only inspection covers the first two positive-shot rows in each of five domains, ten batches/40 images. In the two mesh batches 69/97% of nonzero clean gradient components lie below the old transition. These are target amplitudes, not actual residual gradients or a causal diagnosis. [Units](results/v173-training-unit-inspection-v1.json) · [Gradient distributions](results/v173-training-gradient-inspection-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='The fixed cache has 341 mesh, 243 photo, 156 mixed, 153 flat and 107 weak-detail rows, including the V168 fine-wire/contrast ladder. No new source/noise draws, original/dataz reads or parent/DINO calls occur. Both protected capture families, siblings and JPEGs stay out of training; originals remain read-only. The new inference stage uses the same local conditioning as V172, with exact zero-local-variance routing and whole-image ADC bypass. This is not a noisy-flat guarantee.\n\n'
text+='All 162 focused checks pass (161 CPU tests and one CUDA stream rejection with a stub network), including 13 new independent NumPy value/analytic-derivative, weak/flat descent, constant-error and six-term/mask-isolation checks. New native admission uses three batch-4 512-pixel backwards and one 768-pixel inference, four CUDA matching calls/13 images/three discarded updates. Three actual CUDA criterion values match independent NumPy calculations. Unchanged core/sampler parity and adjoints inherit V172 evidence by source/library hash; old calls are not repeated or counted as new. Atomic CUDA sampler gradients remain warn-only nondeterministic.\n\n'
training_audit=read(root/'training-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"The schedule completes {execution['actual_training_optimizer_updates']} updates, 100 ADC-only skips and 3,600 images. A genuine step-8 checkpoint restores model, Adam, EMA and CPU/CUDA RNG state exactly and continues at step 9 without prefix replay. All 1,000 cached input/parent/unit bindings, {training_audit['FP32_loss_totals_checked']} independently summed NumPy FP32 loss totals, 900 inherited target-mask fingerprints, 141 final Adam states and both strictly loaded raw/EMA states pass. All trainable tensors receive nonzero gradients during training. Exact state restoration does not imply bit-exact retraining.\n\n"
text+='The first preparation rejected only a formatter-induced import-order difference before writing a plan or launching a worker. Original source/work/log and empty output directories remain preserved; work-v2 is the successful freeze. Two unlaunched follow-ups found no plan. The metric frontend and actual endpoint/renderer labels are checked before training. [Preserved failure](results/v173-preparation-failure-v1.json) · [Readiness](results/v173-runtime-readiness-v1.json).\n\n'
text+=f"Quality completes 1,644 composed calls/1,500 new matching calls/7,500 nested samplers. All 1,644 V169 outputs replay exactly and all 144 ADC final outputs retain V169. All 6,576 actual input fingerprints and durable event/row bindings pass. Independent in-process FP32 residual addition covers {audit['allcase_inprocess_addition_channels']:,} channels. V172/V171 comparisons reuse their previously audited scores on identical cached inputs, not new inference.\n\n"
text+=f"Full new arrays cover 36 preselected native cases: 72 RGB plus 72 residuals, 430,196,736 bytes. Independent posthoc metrics/addition check those arrays, {audit['scalar_checks']} scalar values and {audit['independent_native_addition_channels']:,} channels. Other outputs were scored/fingerprinted and independently norm/decomposition/addition checked in process but not retained. No complete new-array archive or full all-822 posthoc array audit is claimed. Decimal arithmetic checks {paired['independent_Decimal_mean_checks']} grouped means.\n\n"
text+=f"New matching work totals {execution['total_new_matching_CUDA_calls']:,} CUDA calls and no CPU matching-core calls; frozen-component CUDA calls total {execution['total_frozen_component_CUDA_calls']:,}. These frozen calls are nested components, not DINO-parent calls. All three scientific owners are terminal, without a failed scientific phase or repeated prefix. Training/quality CUDA peaks are {execution['peak_training_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f}/{execution['peak_quality_CUDA_allocated_bytes']/2**30:.6f} GiB. No new full-frame/100MP or ten-second claim is made.\n\n"
text+='Declared reserves are 50/112 GiB local/external plus a 0.5 GiB projection margin, 32 GiB runtime RAM, 52 GiB launch RAM and 24 GiB CUDA. Older guards and receipt bytes remain unchanged. Existing MIT and embedded Caffe sampler notices remain in provenance.\n\n'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\n'
text+='All 60 figures were actually viewed in 15 original-detail sheets: 48 boards and 12 noisy/restored/exact constructed GT triplets. Each cell retains 160×160 native pixels without resizing. The manifest records source/ROI, checkpoint hash, noise conditioning, exposure, camera transform, contrast and anchor. Mesh uses RGGB 512, ROI [176,176,160,160], shot 0.00128/read variance 6.5536e-6, exposure 8, contrast 1/40. Quiet uses ROI [80,176,160,160], exposure 8 and contrast 40; flats use ROI [176,176,160,160], exposure 4 and contrast 40. ISO12800 uses shot 0.00256/read variance 2.62144e-5. [Photographic source credits](fine-mesh-training.md#photographic-credits).\n\n'
text+='Main DSCF3879 ISO6400/DSCF3880 ISO100 includes sky, building, foliage and coarse fence at exposure 4. Cab DSCF3842/3835 includes both priors, windows [206,229,160,160]/[426,189,160,160] in 768-pixel contexts, exposure 16 and both camera JPEGs. ISO100/AHD/JPEG references differ in aperture, shutter, motion and processing; they are qualitative, not exact GT and not pixelwise scored. [Main scene](../configs/gfx-qualitative-20231231.json) · [Fine cab mesh](../configs/gfx-green-mesh-20231231.json).\n\n'
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
for triplet,title in [(False,'All native comparison boards'),(True,'Noisy, restored and exact constructed GT triplets')]:
 text+='### '+title+'\n\n'
 for item in figures['images']:
  if item['triplet']!=triplet:continue
  text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n![Native comparison](images/v173-weak-gradient-matching-v1/{Path(item['image']['path']).name})\n\n"
text+='[Independent publication verification](results/v173-weak-gradient-matching-publication-verification-v1.json).\n'
report=repo/'docs/weak-gradient-matching.md';report.write_text(text)
save(root/'report-bindings-v1.json',dict(status='built-from-completed-audits-and-actual-native-notes',report=ref(report),notes=ref(notes),cells=cells,lines=lines,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('Built',len(cells),'metric cells;60 native figures')
